spec.note: Pete 2026-10-22: grandma + grandpa geese, shorter and wider (out/shapes/grandpa|grandma.glb). Grandpa B, evening: velvet smoking jacket + tasselled cap.
spec.outfit: a Victorian grandfather in the evening -- a round burgundy velvet smoking cap with a gold tassel; a quilted burgundy velvet smoking jacket with black satin shawl lapels, black frog-and-toggle fastenings across the front and black satin cuffs, tied with a silk cord belt over a round belly; a white shirt with a small black silk cravat; charcoal-grey wool trousers; black velvet slippers embroidered with a small gold motif
spec.style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real fabric textures, clean period tailoring, every garment complete and well fitted to the goose's body. This is an elderly goose: keep the short, stout, round body of picture 1 exactly -- do not make it taller or slimmer. Warm and cosy, not a costume-party exaggeration: no cane, no props in the hands. The goose keeps its own head exactly: black head and neck, white cheek patch, eyes and beak unchanged. The goose has NO tail.

view_hint.left: Side profile: the cap and tassel in profile, the round belly under the belted jacket. Keep the feet and legs exactly where they are in picture 1.
view_hint.right: Side profile: the cap and tassel in profile, the round belly under the belted jacket. Keep the feet and legs exactly where they are in picture 1.
